explanation: Frobenius reciprocity says $\langle\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W,V\rangle_G=\langle W,\mathrm{Res}_H^G V\rangle_H$, expressing that induction is left adjoint to restriction. The first distractor applies $\mathrm{Res}$ to the $H$-representation $W$ (ill-typed); the second drops $\mathrm{Res}$ entirely; and the last swaps the roles, wrongly making restriction the left adjoint.
